shots.description: Corner of the waistband and front flap panel folded onto an oval brushed-pewter tray, a gold ring and an antique gold key resting on the folded fabric, near-black warm-brown backdrop.
shots.camera: Static, 45-degree overhead, macro-to-medium, shallow depth of field
shots.prompt: EXACTLY the black pinstripe Flap Trouser (as in Flap Trouser Black.png) — pixel-faithful colorway and texture, plain waistband with no belt loops, no monogram, no tag or logo of any kind. A corner of the waistband and the front drape flap panel is folded and draped over an oval brushed-pewter tray, showing the diagonal flap seam and pinstripe texture clearly. A slim gold ring and a small antique gold key rest on the folded fabric, echoing a jewelry-on-fabric styling detail. Near-black warm-brown backdrop, soft single-source top-left light with gentle shadow falloff to the right, no harsh specular highlights. Minimal moody studio still-life product photography, no model, no environment, subtle film-grain texture, warm neutral color temperature. Square or vertical framing.
